title: [BUG] [alpha] RenameWidget applies rename edits twice for current file
summary: Rename applies workspace edits via backend for all files and then applies current file edits again with model.pushEditOperations.
steps: Run rename where current editor file is included in workspaceEdit.changes.
Observe backend apply executes for current URI in loop.
Observe current model path applies same edits again afterward.
expected: Each text edit should be applied exactly once per affected file.
actual: Current file receives both backend and model edit application paths.
